title: MessageProducerContribution
description: A code-declared outbound message producer: Kafka `KafkaTemplate.send`, AMQP `RabbitTemplate.convertAndSend`, JMS `JmsTemplate.send`, AWS SQS `SendMessage`, NATS `Publish`, NestJS `ClientProxy.emit/send`, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` today; future broker-specific KSs.

producerSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the call site / method that publishes (a class field or call-expression target). Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

destinations.description: Topics / queues / subjects the producer publishes to (when statically resolvable).

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). E.g. Kafka partitioner / serializer, AMQP exchange/routingKey, headers contract.
